aboutPage.metaDescription: About Talir — end-of-day Macedonian Stock Exchange data
aboutPage.title: About Talir
aboutPage.lead: Talir surfaces end-of-day market data and regulatory filings from the Macedonian Stock Exchange and SECNet — not a live news wire.
aboutPage.etymologyBody: Talir comes from the historical silver thaler — a coin that served for centuries as an international measure of value. The same etymological root stands behind the word “dollar”.
aboutPage.markBody: The mark is a coin with an oak acorn at its centre: the oak as a symbol of durability and wealth built across generations. The acorn is the core — long-horizon growth, not short-term noise.
aboutPage.projectBody: Talir compiles public MSE listings and issuer disclosures on SECNet. Figures reflect the last available end-of-day close unless stated otherwise. Content is informational and does not constitute investment advice.
aboutPage.visionBody: Transparent, local-language access to Macedonian market data for long-horizon investors who want a clear end-of-day view.
aboutPage.operatorBody: Talir is operated by ETER MARKETING DOO Skopje. Product contact: contact@talir.mk (draft — subject to change).
aboutPage.founderBody: Ivan (draft) — founder of Talir and ETER MARKETING. Short editable bio placeholder kept in the app dictionary for easy updates.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.lead: This policy describes how ETER MARKETING DOO Skopje (“we”) process personal data when you use Talir (talir.mk).
privacyPage.controllerBody: Data controller: ETER MARKETING DOO Skopje. Privacy requests: privacy@talir.mk (draft contact).
privacyPage.collectBody: We may collect: account email and authentication metadata; synced alerts, portfolios, and watchlists; newsletter subscription if you opt in; and technical logs such as IP via hosting and processors.
privacyPage.purposesBody: We process data to provide your account and sync features (contract), to keep the service secure and reliable (legitimate interest), and — where required — with consent (e.g. marketing newsletter).
privacyPage.processorsBody: We use: Supabase (auth and database), Resend (transactional email), and Vercel (hosting and delivery). They act as processors under their terms and our instructions.
privacyPage.retentionBody: Account data is kept while the account is active and for a reasonable period afterward for security or legal obligations. We apply standard technical and organisational measures; no system is risk-free.
privacyPage.transfersBody: Some processors may process data outside the EU/EEA. Where applicable, we rely on appropriate safeguards offered by those providers (e.g. standard contractual clauses).
privacyPage.rightsBody: Under the GDPR you may have rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection, and restriction, where applicable. You may lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Agency (АЗЛП) in North Macedonia.
privacyPage.cookiesBody: We use local storage for theme, language/preferences, and local drafts (alerts, lists) before sync. We do not run third-party advertising cookies on core market pages.
privacyPage.contactBody: For privacy requests email privacy@talir.mk or contact the controller at the company address. We will respond within a reasonable time.
privacyPage.footnote: This text is an informational draft and not formal legal advice. Contact the controller for formal requests.

index.ombDescription: The OMB is the bond index of the Macedonian Stock Exchange. It tracks the performance of government and corporate bonds listed on the exchange.
